answer: Admission auctions stop bulk forgery. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; bidders lock funds in a vault and the top bids win, so no forger can wander in for free. Each slot carries a ferrous seal, an iron-bound deposit that burns if the identity is caught cheating. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 wins at $40 each: $40,000. An honest agent pays $40 once. Auction prices rise as forgers bid against each other, so bulk forgery funds its own defeat.
